Features

Everything your team needs

A comprehensive suite of modules built for the demands of modern healthcare facilities.

Report Module

Configurable, template-based data collection forms. Standardise how staff record observations, assessments, and care events.

Timeline Module

Chronological event log with powerful filtering by date, category, and staff member. Ideal for handovers and incident reviews.

Graphs Module

Turn collected report data into trend charts and dashboards. Spot patterns early without exporting to spreadsheets.

Medical / Medication

Track medication schedules, dosages, and administration records per patient. Reduce errors with structured medication workflows.

Audit Trail

Every write operation is logged, timestamped, and linked in an immutable hash chain. Meets regulatory compliance requirements out of the box.

Reminders

Configure period-based reminders — daily, weekly, or custom intervals — so nothing falls through the cracks.

Multi-platform

One product, every device. Full-featured web application, native iOS and Android apps — all from a single codebase.

NFC Authentication

Tap a registered NFC device to authenticate instantly. No password typing in clinical settings — fast, secure, hands-free.

Multi-language

Fully localised in English, German, Italian, French, and Romanian. Every user works in their preferred language.

Role-Based Access

Fine-grained RBAC for every team role. Administrators, nurses, doctors — each sees only what they need.

Cloud-Native

Kubernetes-native deployment. Scale horizontally, deploy with zero downtime, run on your own infrastructure or ours.

Modules

Built for every workflow

Each module is independently configurable and integrates seamlessly with the rest of the platform.

Report Module

Build structured data collection forms from reusable templates. Standardise how staff record observations, assessments, and care events — with full category and action configuration, without writing a single line of code.

Timeline Module

Every event, in order. Filter by date range, category, or staff member to surface exactly what happened and when — ideal for handovers, incident reviews, and continuity of care.

Graphs Module

Turn collected report data into trend charts and time-aggregated dashboards. Spot patterns early, track outcomes over time, and share insights — all without exporting to spreadsheets.

Medical / Medication

Manage medication schedules, dosages, and administration records per patient. Structured workflows for preparation, administration, and cleanup reduce errors and keep your team accountable.

Audit Trail

Every write operation is logged, timestamped, and linked in an immutable hash chain. Audit records cannot be altered retroactively — providing full chain-of-custody for every data change and meeting regulatory compliance requirements out of the box.

Reminders

Configure period-based reminders with custom conditions and labels — daily, weekly, or tailored intervals. Ensure recurring tasks and care checks are never missed, regardless of shift changes.

Platform

Any device, any language

Froggi meets your team wherever they are — in the office, at the bedside, or on the move.

Web

Full-featured browser application. No installation required — works on any modern browser, including Safari, Chrome, and Firefox.

iOS & Android

Native mobile apps with the same data and features as the web app. Optimised for tablet and phone, with offline-capable design.

NFC Authentication

Staff tap a registered NFC tag to authenticate instantly. Designed for fast, hands-free access in clinical environments where typing is impractical.

Security & Trust

Built for regulated environments

Healthcare data demands the highest standards. Froggi is designed from the ground up for security, compliance, and reliability.

Role-Based Access Control

Every user sees only what their role permits. Granular permissions for administrators, clinical staff, and read-only viewers — all managed centrally. Supports LDAP/SSO integration for enterprise environments.

Immutable Audit Log

Hash-chain integrity means audit records cannot be altered retroactively. Full chain-of-custody for every data change — from who made it to when — satisfying regulatory and compliance requirements out of the box.

Cloud-Native Infrastructure

Kubernetes-native deployment with horizontal scaling and zero-downtime updates. Run on your own infrastructure or let us manage it. Cloudflare Tunnel ingress, Vault secrets management, and Redis session caching included.
